name: icon-cloud
title: Icon Cloud
description: A canvas showing dozens of small brand icons arranged on a sphere, with front logos bright and rear ones faded, rotating on its own and spinning when dragged.
use: A product wants to show a large set of tech or brand logos as a rotating globe.
avoid: Phones or keyboard-only users; the canvas has no touch or keyboard controls.
a11y: The canvas is labelled as a 3D icon cloud but has no keyboard or touch controls, and the auto-spin ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A loose circular cluster of small, colourful developer logos on black, with no visible sphere outline. Logos near the middle-front are sharp and bright, while those toward the edges fade almost to black.
behaves: The whole cluster turns slowly as if on a globe, logging drifting in and out of focus. Dragging spins it with the pointer, and clicking a logo eases the globe round to face it.
customise: Pass an images array of URLs, or icons nodes; the 400px canvas size, sphere layout and drag physics are fixed in the source.
weight: heavy: A canvas redraws every icon on every frame in a requestAnimationFrame loop.
